duas.arabic: شَهِدْنَا أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
duas.english: We testify that there is no god but Allah.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
O Allah, keep our hearts firm on truth.
My Lord, expand for me my breast.
O Allah, enable us to recite Your verses.
O Allah, make us among those who preserve Your Book.
O Allah, send blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad.
O Allah, enable me to have good character.
O Allah, protect me from badness and anger.
My Lord, enable me to remember You.
O Allah, open upon us wisdom.
My Lord, do not make me among the heedless.
My Lord, make me steadfast in prayer.
O Allah, enable excellence in my prayer.
My Lord, I ask You for Your forgiveness and mercy.
O Allah, guide our hearts toward standing for You.
O Allah, accept our fasting and prayers.
My Lord, make me among the patient.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خُلُقِي قُرْآنًا مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا
duas.english: O Allah, make my character a Quran from my heart.
O Allah, illuminate my heart.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَيْسِرْ لِي النِّعْمَةَ فِي كَلَامِي
duas.english: O Allah, ease blessings in my speech.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي سَبَبًا فِي سَلَامِ الْبِلَادِ
duas.english: O Allah, make me a reason for the peace of the lands.
O Allah, make my words beautiful.
My Lord, enable me toward peace.
O Allah, complete Your blessings upon us.
O Allah, let us listen and follow.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُحَافِظِينَ عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: My Lord, make me among those who protect Your religion.
O Allah, grant me guidance.
My Lord, increase me in forbearance.
O Allah, inspire me with a path that pleases You.
My Lord, forgive and have mercy.
O Allah, make me among those who seek forgiveness.
My Lord, send down Your mercy upon us.
My Lord, I am overcome, so help me.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى السُّوءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا سَبَبًا لَهُ
duas.english: O Allah, help us avoid evil and do not make us its cause.
O Allah, ease judgment and fairness for us.
My Lord, enable me to thank You.
O Allah, reward them for what You love.
O Allah, make me among those who respond to dua.
O Allah, make us among the grateful.
My Lord, fill our hearts with goodness.
O Allah, make us love what You love.
O Allah, I ask You for tranquility of heart.
My Lord, I ask You for Paradise.
O Allah, save us from the Fire.
